name: Sweet Space
tagline: Ice cream, shakes, popsicles and natural juices in New Caney, plus an ice cream truck for events.
about: Sweet Space in New Caney serves ice cream, shakes, popsicles and natural juices.
The ice cream truck comes to events and festivals, and Sweet Space also rents chairs and tables, with delivery for a fee.
